description: One hotel's details (address, coordinates, stars, rating, photos, description, facilities, check-in and check-out times, parking) and, with dates, every bookable room: offer_id, room, board, refundable, cancellation_summary and the free cancellation deadline, total, per night, taxes included, taxes at the property, due_at_property_total, and a book_url a person can open. Prices are the total for the whole stay for one room, in the currency asked (EUR by default), as Nuitee, the booking partner and merchant of record, charges them, with the taxes Nuitee collects included. Taxes and fees paid at the property (often a city or tourist tax) are listed in taxes_at_property, summed in due_at_property_total, and are not in the total.

adults.description: Adults in the one room, 1 to 8. Default 2.

checkin.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD, today (UTC) to 500 days ahead.

checkout.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD, 1 to 30 nights after check-in.

children.description: Ages of children in the room, if any, at most 4.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for the prices, default EUR.

nationality.description: Guest nationality, ISO 3166 alpha-2 (prices can depend on it). Default from the client's language, else NL.
